channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: Thailand SEC sets Oct. 16 rules for bitcoin, ether ETFs
item.description: Thailand’s SEC issued 11 crypto ETF notifications effective Oct. 16, allowing initial funds to track bitcoin or ether under custody, exposure and investor safeguards.

item.title: ESMA sets three-month deadline for legacy stablecoin exposure
item.description: ESMA told national supervisors to curb EU crypto firms’ services for non-MiCA stablecoins, allowing only a short, controlled exit for existing holders.

item.title: Samsung Wallet will add USDC remittances for Galaxy users
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet in late October, letting eligible US Galaxy owners send crypto abroad or pay out to bank accounts in over 60 countries.

item.title: Choosing Pool Fees for a New Token Pair on SushiSwap
item.description: For a new token pair, the right pool fee balances trader cost against the return liquidity providers need to keep quoting through volatility and thin liquidity.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for midterm spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the Senate’s CLARITY Act remains stalled.

item.title: Aibai and the mechanics of bridging crypto from a wallet
item.description: Aibai uses a wallet-authorised bridge to move assets across blockchains; the route, fees and destination network determine what arrives and what you need next.

item.title: Polymarket tests V2 market system ahead of tentative Nov. 2 shift
item.description: Polymarket is testing Protocol V2, which puts new markets on one positions contract and pUSD collateral, with modular oracle resolution and a tentative Nov. 2 shift.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates who supported the stalled CLARITY Act, including six with $1 million each, as the industry eyes a new Congress.

item.title: Fairshake targets 32 House races with crypto campaign spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six set to receive $1 million each, as crypto market rules remain stalled in the Senate.

item.title: OKX-ICE venture sets out 24/7 tokenized stock venue
item.description: OKX and ICE filed notice for a 24/7 tokenized stock venue on X Layer, using gated liquidity pools under a temporary SEC exemption for US investors.

item.title: Keep Both Sides of a Cross-Network Crypto Transfer
item.description: A cross-network transfer creates evidence on more than one chain; keep the source and destination records, bridge status, and the details that connect them.

item.title: How to Confirm a Polygon Bridge Transfer From Your Wallet
item.description: A Polygon bridge transfer is confirmed in stages: verify the source transaction, identify the deposit or withdrawal path, then check the destination wallet.

item.title: An Omnichain Swap Starts With the Token Contracts
item.description: An omnichain swap depends on contracts on both chains. Check each token address, approval, route and recovery rule before signing the source-chain transaction.

item.title: Ethereum’s zkAPI separates AI payments from user identity
item.description: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity put zkAPI on mainnet, using zero-knowledge proofs to separate metered AI payments from users’ identities.

item.title: What a Polygon Withdrawal Checkpoint Proves
item.description: A Polygon withdrawal checkpoint commits a range of PoS blocks to Ethereum, letting bridge contracts verify a burn before releasing the matching asset.

item.title: A bridge transfer leaves records on two chains
item.description: A bridge transfer creates evidence on two chains, and a useful tax export preserves the amounts, fees, timestamps and transaction links needed to reconcile it.

item.title: How to consolidate crypto proceeds across different chains
item.description: Consolidating crypto proceeds means choosing a destination chain, moving each asset through a route, then reconciling balances and fees before reuse.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Swaps Can Deliver Less Than the Quote
item.description: A cross-chain quote can shrink before arrival as network costs, pool pricing, slippage and execution timing affect different parts of the swap and its payout.

item.title: Why Polygon withdrawal claims appear after the burn
item.description: Polygon PoS withdrawals burn tokens first; Ethereum releases them only after validators checkpoint the burn block and a proof is ready for a separate claim.

item.title: How Wallet-Funded Swaps Trade Without Exchange Deposits
item.description: A wallet-funded swap moves tokens from your wallet through a trading route, avoiding an exchange deposit while leaving fees, approvals and execution on-chain.
